title: Visitors, how many and when
about: How many visitors are present in a place on an average day of each month, and from where, from the nights spent in its tourist accommodation, read under every declared reading of "visitor": registered establishments only; platform rentals too; stays with friends and relatives or in second homes, which no return holds, at a declared rate; same-day visitors at a declared rate for declared hours. Each reading gives its own stock. Intensity (visitors per thousand residents, nights per resident, per km²) and seasonality (the peak month over the mean, the Gini coefficient over the year's days) are judged against bands where someone declares them. The returns are Eurostat's, by month and residence of the guest. The mathematics is urban science's, with nomos's Gini.
